article.title: Constitutional validity of State laws not to be considered in proceedings under article 32
article.content:
32AConstitutional validity of State laws not to be considered in proceedings under article 32

Article 32A · Part III · Right to Constitutional Remedies
Omitted by the Constitution (Forty-third Amendment) Act, 1977, s. 3 (w.e.f. 13-4-1978).

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976, s. 6 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
